approved_policy: 2026-10-22; fixed 5km; status brackets each <=10s; NACp engineering disks; continuous reference and constrained path; longitudinal 2m/s2 and lateral 35deg separated

vectoring_generator.reference_fit: minimum-jerk quintic interpolant of real updates and provenance-preserving grid constraints
vectoring_generator.residual_bound: each original observation within its NACp engineering disk; no extra allowance
vectoring_generator.route_search: nonnegative degree-eight chord-normal displacement; three free controls; local SLSQP minimum of integrated squared jerk
vectoring_generator.joins: C2 with continuous reference; original altitude and outside samples retained
vectoring_generator.on_failure: reject; do not shrink 5km, extend time, fill data or relax limits
vectoring_generator.limitations: restricted search; conditional reference model; ground-motion proxies; no global optimum or aircraft-specific certification

seed_policy: Original candidate order and random sides are generated deterministically; geometry-rejected candidates receive no dose; survivors retain relative order

threshold_basis.geometry: Continuous chord-forward reference and path; unique interior nearest-route projection; Bernstein interval verification; see reports/vectoring-continuous-generator.md
threshold_basis.position_freshness: OpenSky state-vector lastposupdate field; existing source age limit 15 s
threshold_basis.speed_retention: Explicit engineering screen, not a published flight limit
threshold_basis.bank_proxy: EUROCONTROL BADA 3.5 User Manual (2003), nominal civil bank 35 deg outside takeoff/landing; https://www.eurocontrol.int/sites/default/files/library/017_BADA_3_5_User_Manual.pdf

vectoring_screen.interpretation: reject-only diagnostic screens; ground-track proxies, not aircraft-specific certification
